options.name: config
options.description: A dictionary of IP access-list options

options.name: running_config
options.description: This option is used only with state I(parsed). The value of this option should be the output received from the EOS device by executing the command B(show running-config | section access-list). The state I(parsed) reads the configuration from C(running_config) option and transforms it into Ansible structured data as per the resource module's argspec and the value is then returned in the I(parsed) key within the result.

options.name: state
options.description: The state the configuration should be left in.
